function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign from the initial vulnerability disclosure through October 1, 2026, using only verifiable evidence and returning source IDs for every material statement. Build a complete chronological timeline covering: the relevant vulnerability or vulnerabilities and exact disclosure, patch, and advisory dates; discovery and exploitation of vulnerable MOVEit Transfer instances; observed attack techniques and indicators; deployment, behavior, filenames, paths, access mechanisms, and characteristics of the LEMURLOOT web shell and any related tooling; public reporting by vendors, researchers, affected organizations, and government or law-enforcement bodies; attribution statements involving FIN11, CL0P, TA505, or other names, clearly separating confirmed facts from allegations and analytical assessments; extortion sites, leak sites, domains, IP addresses, certificates, hosting, cryptocurrency or other infrastructure, and evidence linking that infrastructure to the campaign; relevant organizations and relationships only where explicitly supported. Identify contradictions, unresolved attribution questions, temporal gaps, and differences between sources. Do not infer unsupported relationships. Return a source-indexed evidence pack with exact source IDs as provided by the benchmark, publication dates, quoted or closely paraphrased evidence, confidence labels, and a chronology suitable for a final report. Do not rely on unstated background knowledge, and do not invent source IDs."}
function.name: ConductResearch
